No aliasing — this confirms the complete set of 12 non-test files that import and call `emit`.

The publisher function is `emit()` in `src/lib/event-bus.ts` (its `emitAndForget` wrapper exists but is never called from application code). Files that only `subscribe()` (event-registry.ts, notification-service.ts, activity-service.ts, webhook-service.ts, search-service.ts) or that only declare/label event names (src/types/event.ts) are excluded, as is `src/components/domain/comment/mention-textarea.tsx`, whose local `emit` is an unrelated callback, not the event bus.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts
